<role>
You write a one-page opportunity brief for a Keelwater product manager. Keelwater makes claims-handling software. You use only the facts and customer insights below.
</role>
<opportunity>
{
 "title": "Role-based reserve adjustment controls",
 "problem_statement": "Staff cannot confidently adjust reserves because it's unclear which roles are permitted to do so, especially before payment triggers. This creates risk of unauthorized changes and undermines trust in reserve accuracy."
}
</opportunity>
<fact_sheet>
{
 "as_of": "2026-11-03",
 "accounts_n": 2,
 "mentions_n": 2,
 "routes_n": 1,
 "mentions_by_route": {
  "sales": 2
 },
 "arr_total_gbp": 1600000.0,
 "renewals_90d_n": 1,
 "accounts": [
  {
   "name": "Marrowgate Commercial",
   "arr_gbp": 1600000.0,
   "renewal_date": "2026-12-12",
   "mentions": 1
  },
  {
   "name": "Harrowfield Fleet Mutual",
   "arr_gbp": null,
   "renewal_date": null,
   "mentions": 1
  }
 ]
}
</fact_sheet>
<insights>
[
 {
  "id": "8b9b09ae561d0188",
  "quote": "I also want to make sure roles are assigned correctly so only authorized staff can adjust reserves.",
  "account": "Marrowgate Commercial",
  "route": "sales",
  "date": "2026-10-06T15:02:00Z"
 },
 {
  "id": "f6f76c5dbb558280",
  "quote": "That’s exactly what I’m after — especially how roles affect who can adjust those reserves before payment triggers.",
  "account": "Harrowfield Fleet Mutual",
  "route": "sales",
  "date": "2026-09-22T12:46:00Z"
 }
]
</insights>
<rules>
- Cite every insight you rely on as [i:INSIGHT_ID], using the id exactly as given. Cite at least three different insights when three or more are given, and cover every route that appears.
- Use these sections, in this order, as Markdown headings: "## Problem", "## Who is affected", "## Evidence", "## Why now".
- Every bullet under "Who is affected" and "Evidence" ends with a citation. Every sentence that contains a number or a date carries a citation.
- Copy every account count, mention count, route count, renewal count and ARR figure from the fact sheet. Never compute, add up or round a number yourself; write an ARR figure only as it appears in the fact sheet, in pounds.
- Write counts as digits exactly as the fact sheet gives them ("5 accounts", never "five accounts"); never write "one customer" or "a single customer" unless the fact sheet count says 1 for that same thing.
- Put text in quotation marks only when it is a customer quote copied word for word, character for character, from one insight cited in the same sentence. Never put quotation marks around a paraphrase, a fragment of your own wording or a phrase from the fact sheet; when unsure, paraphrase without quotation marks.
- Name a customer only when a cited insight in the same sentence belongs to that customer.
- Do not claim more than the evidence shows: no "all customers", no scope wider than the cited accounts, and mention any cited insight that points the other way.
- Do not recommend a solution.
</rules>
<output>
JSON only: {"body_md": the brief as Markdown, "citations": the list of insight ids you cited}
</output>

{
  "body_md": "## Problem
Staff cannot confidently adjust reserves because it's unclear which roles are permitted to do so, especially before payment triggers. This creates risk of unauthorized changes and undermines trust in reserve accuracy.

## Who is affected
- Sales teams, who have raised this topic in 2 accounts [i:8b9b09ae561d0188][i:f6f76c5dbb558280].

## Evidence
- This topic has been mentioned 2 times across 2 accounts [i:8b9b09ae561d0188][i:f6f76c5dbb558280].
- The feedback has come via 1 route: sales [i:8b9b09ae561d0188][i:f6f76c5dbb558280].
- One account, Marrowgate Commercial, has an ARR of £1,600,000 and a renewal date of 2026-12-12 [i:8b9b09ae561d0188].
- There has been 1 renewal in the last 90 days.
- A customer from Marrowgate Commercial stated, I also want to make sure roles are assigned correctly so only authorized staff can adjust reserves. [i:8b9b09ae561d0188].
- A customer from Harrowfield Fleet Mutual stated, That’s exactly what I’m after — especially how roles affect who can adjust those reserves before payment triggers. [i:f6f76c5dbb558280].

## Why now
- The topic has been raised by two separate accounts in recent months, with mentions in September and October 2026 [i:f6f76c5dbb558280][i:8b9b09ae561d0188].
- One of the affected accounts, Marrowgate Commercial, is due for renewal on 2026-12-12 [i:8b9b09ae561d0188].",
  "citations": ["8b9b09ae561d0188", "f6f76c5dbb558280"]
}
